asset_heavy.reason: Online insurance marketplace and broker; needs technology and agents, not plants, fleets or properties.

big_ticket.reason: Medicare and health insurance plan enrollments are routine policies with modest premiums, not large infrequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Health and Medicare insurance is essential coverage; customers rarely drop it in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individuals and families enrolling in Medicare and health plans; carriers pay commissions.

notes: Website text was an error page; answers rely on prior knowledge of eHealth as a Medicare and health insurance broker.

offers_products.reason: It sells no goods of its own; it brokers insurance plans from carriers.

offers_services.reason: Insurance brokerage and enrollment help for Medicare and health plans, with agent consultations; insurance counts as services.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is carrier commissions via a technology platform and agents; platform and carrier relationships matter, not just staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Commissions come from policies that renew, with ongoing renewal commissions on Medicare Advantage and other plans.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals, families and Medicare-eligible seniors choose and enroll in plans through eHealth.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance carriers pay commissions and marketing fees; it also serves some employers and small businesses.
